system.description: As a Full-Round Action, you can beguile one or more targets of your choice within 6 squares and line of sight, making a Persuasion check against their Will Defense. If successful, the targets suffer a -5 penalty to Perception checks for one round. You can keep the targets captivated as a Full-Round Action each subsequent round, making a new Persuasion check each time. The effect immediately ends if the targets are attacked or threatened.
